components.title: compliant-s3
components.description: Reusable Terraform pattern for an AWS S3 primary bucket plus a dedicated access-log bucket. Hardcodes server-side encryption, versioning, public access block, access logging, and required compliance tags.
components.purpose: Provide a compliant-by-default S3 primitive that any team can adopt with three lines of consumer Terraform.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST 800-53 Rev 5 controls satisfied by this module.

implemented-requirements.description: AES-256 server-side encryption is enforced via aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration. Hardcoded; consumers cannot override.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json.

implemented-requirements.description: aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block enforces block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, and restrict_public_buckets on both buckets, denying every public access vector at the resource level.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json.

implemented-requirements.description: aws_s3_bucket_logging targets the dedicated log bucket (access-logs/ prefix) so every request against the primary bucket produces an audit record with the content required to establish what occurred.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json.

implemented-requirements.description: default_tags on the AWS provider apply required compliance tags (Project, Environment, ManagedBy, ComplianceScope) to every taggable resource, and aws_s3_bucket_versioning keeps prior object states so configuration drift is recoverable and auditable.

links.text: Signed pipeline bundle containing terraform plan.json.
